text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Umm, a lemon, a light bulb, and... yep! I 
got all the materials we need for science 
class!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! What was that teacher thinking, 
running a witch ragged on errands like 
this—"

text_block_list.name: Person Walking Dog
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me!! Someone catch that doggy, 
pleaseee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that won't do! A proper master 
shouldn't let go of their familiar!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! That acceleration just now! It 
was like her engine went full throttle in 
a split second!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though you said you were 
exhausted...! Is that the power of magic 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Well, of course! I work hard every 
day as a witch, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘Run even faster when you're tired’... 
you say?"
choice_data_list:
I wanna boost my explosive power in the 
spurt, too!

I want to improve my explosive power in 
the final spurt, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? ...Well, Grandma did say that 'when 
your magic runs low, that's when a witch 
shows what she's truly made of.'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll play along. In return, if you 
serve me any half-baked menu, I'm going 
home right then and there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
... ...Guess that workout routine was no 
joke.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Sweep, what's the matter? Did 
something happen recently?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing! Come on, let's hurry up 
and head home!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Well, maybe that familiar is being a 
little bit useful. Just a little!)
